records.part: Addition of fifteen (15) National Stock Numbers (NSNs)/Part Numbers (PNs) to the Alpha VI IDR Long-Term Contract supporting the Patriot Missile System

records.reason: This solicitation is issued on a sole-source basis to Raytheon Company (CAGE 05716) pursuant to 10 U.S.C. § 3204(a)(1) and FAR 6.302-1, as only one responsible source is capable of satisfying the Government’s requirements.
